# Research — Tomáš Guth Jarkovský

_Date: 2026-06-18 (refresh) · LinkedIn body blocked (HTTP 999); built from public web sources + LinkedIn headline._

## Who he is (2–3 sentences)
Czech technologist, AI educator, and human-rights advocate. His professional identity now
leads with **AI** — LinkedIn headline reads **"AI-Powered Project Manager & Product Owner"** —
backed by software PM / product work, game design, and a commercial **AI tutoring & consulting**
offering for schools and businesses. Alongside this he is an **Amnesty International** advocacy
specialist, a **photographer** (his own brand: Guth Pictures), and an MFF UK informatics graduate
(b. 1996).

## Profile
- **Education:** Informatics, Faculty of Mathematics & Physics, Charles University (MFF UK);
  Biskupské gymnázium, České Budějovice.
- **Base:** České Budějovice / South Bohemia + Prague.
- **Hats (current weighting):** ① AI-powered PM / product · ② AI educator & consultant
  (schools + firms) · ③ human-rights advocacy (Amnesty) · ④ game design (Rolling, intl. affairs) ·
  ⑤ photographer.

## What changed since 2026-06-17 (refresh deltas)
- **AI is now the lead identity**, not one hat among many — headline literally "AI-Powered
  Project Manager & Product Owner"; AI tutoring/consulting is a productized commercial service.
- **Party role faded** — pirati.cz now lists him only as **"registrovaný příznivec od 25. 3.
  2025"** (registered supporter), not an active functionary / deputy head. The hard-political
  register is weaker; civic-supporter / human-rights register remains.
- **Rolling** — "Director of international affairs" at *Rolling* (spolek for experiential
  educational games, Terezín) → game-design hat is concrete and internationally framed.

## Focus areas
AI literacy & tooling, software product/PM, experiential/educational game design, human rights,
digital rights, gender equality, humanitarian response to war.

## Audience (who the photos must convince)
- **Business / AI-training clients** (schools, firms buying workshops & consulting) — competent,
  contemporary, trustworthy, clear communicator. **Primary commercial audience now.**
- Tech / product peers & hiring managers (modern, credible PM/product operator).
- NGO / human-rights community (credibility, gravitas, authenticity).
- Czech public & civic networks (approachable, principled, modern).

## Brand voice
Principled, substantive, modern-progressive, competence-forward. Earnest but not stiff; values
authenticity and craft over polish-for-polish's-sake. Now with a sharper, more contemporary
tech edge than the earlier read suggested.

## Current visual identity
- No personal website given for the subject; present on Instagram (`@tgjarkovsky`),
  X (`@TGuthJarkovsky`). Runs his own photo brand **Guth Pictures**.
- **Note:** he is himself a photographer + AI instructor → a visually literate, discerning
  subject. Concepts must be craft-forward and concept-driven, not generic corporate stock.
- Amnesty visual language skews humanist photojournalism (candid, real, often desaturated / b&w);
  AI-educator / tech register skews contemporary, well-lit, modern, screen-glow friendly.

## Competitive / category visual landscape
- **AI educators / tech consultants (CZ):** contemporary, approachable, well-lit; stage /
  workshop / laptop context; clean modern palettes, occasional cool accent.
- **Advocacy / NGO leaders:** candid, environmental, human-centered, documentary; authenticity
  over gloss.
- **Product / PM operators:** clean, confident, modern-minimal; studio or modern-workspace.
- **Gap to exploit:** few sit at *human-rights gravitas* + *AI/tech credibility*. A look fusing
  humanist warmth with modern technologist clarity is distinctive and uniquely his.

## Opportunities
- Lead the set with the **AI-educator / modern-technologist** register (his current commercial
  engine), supported by a humanist-advocate register for Amnesty/NGO contexts — a **modular set**
  usable across workshops, product/PM, speaking, advocacy.
- Lean into authenticity (his audiences distrust over-polish) while keeping it sharp and modern.
- He's a photographer — the proposal can be more craft-ambitious than a standard corporate shoot.

## Visual keywords
**modern-technologist · clear/competent · humanist · candid-but-considered · principled**
Palette leanings: contemporary neutrals + a confident cool or warm accent; clean modern light,
with a documentary-warm option for the advocacy register.

concepts.title: Modern Technologist / AI Educator

concepts.why: headline is "AI-Powered PM & Product Owner"; sells AI workshops + consulting to schools & firms; MFF UK informatics + game design. Tech-educator visual norms = contemporary, teaching/stage/workspace context (research: AI is now the lead hat).
concepts.mood: sharp, modern, engaged, forward — the most energetic of the three.
concepts.wardrobe: smart-casual contemporary — clean shirt or fine knit, modern, uncluttered.
concepts.location: teaching/stage, modern workspace, at screen/whiteboard; cool ambient + accent.
concepts.lighting: modern mixed — soft key + cool practical / screen glow as accent; motion-friendly.
concepts.poseDirection: dynamic, gestural, in-the-moment; hands active; engaged energy, not static.

concepts.location: real environments — desk with papers, bookshelf, window light, urban exterior.
concepts.lighting: natural / available light, soft directional from window; documentary, not staged.
shotList: tight candid headshot, eyes to camera
